verbs.nuance_ko: 갑작스러운 상황에 심하게 놀라거나 당황했을 때 캐주얼하게 쓰는 대표적인 구어 표현입니다.
verbs.example: I totally freaked out when I realized I left my laptop on the subway this morning.
verbs.my_line: I freaked out for a second when my boss called me into the meeting unexpectedly today.

verbs.nuance_ko: 숨겨둔 감정이나 고민을 솔직하게 이야기할 때 쓰이며 보통 'open up to someone' 형태로 자주 쓰입니다.
verbs.example: It usually takes a long time for him to open up to new coworkers at work.
verbs.my_line: I had coffee with a close colleague today and finally opened up about my recent stress.
